مَصْبُورٌ [pass. part. n. of 1, q. v. Confined, &c. ―
-b2- ] Confined [with bonds or otherwise], (K,) or set up, (M,) to be put to death: (M, K:) and ↓ رَجُلٌ صَبُورَةٌ a man confined, (K,) or set up, (M,) to be put to death; (M, K;) i. q. مَصْبُورٌ لِلْقَتْلِ: (Th, M, K:) and مَصْبُورَةٌ, applied to a beast (بَهِيمَةٌ, A), confined [or bound] to be put to death [and in that state killed by arrows or the like]; i. q. مَحْبُوسَةٌ عَلَى المَوْتِ: such is forbidden to be eaten. (S, A.) ―
-b3- مَصْبُورَةٌ applied to an oath: see صَبْرٌ. ＝
-A2- Also Made into a صُبْرَة, like a صُبْرَة of wheat; so gathered or collected together. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
